article.story: CARROLLTON, Ga. -- — Shelton Williams-Dryden's 24 points helped West Georgia defeat Lipscomb 84-77 on Wednesday night. Williams-Dryden added seven rebounds for the Wolves (13-16, 7-10 Atlantic Sun Conference). Josh Smith scored 17 points, shooting 7 of 9 from the field. Kolten Griffin had 12 points and went 5 of 10 from the field (2 for 4 from 3-point range). Ross Candelino and Grant Asman each finished with 14 points for the Bisons (18-12, 11-6). Cole Middleton finished with 11 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
